premise: A receiver intended to request help keeps attracting visitors. Reed must decide whether an answer is a rescue message or a survey command.
cast: Reed: saved scarf/white-circle/black-stick identity, grounded grey school pack.
Eve: adult technician in rust work vest, white head/hands/feet; ankle injury late.
Malik: adult caretaker in olive jacket, white head/hands/feet; sleeve torn during descent.
One canonical Surveyor and one canonical Loader with lifting machine; no late unexplained costume variants.
locations: Dome/public entrance -> hall/radio room -> caretaker kitchen -> service cupboard.
Cupboard trench hatch -> under-yard trench -> supply-shed grate.
Shed -> fallen signpost/loose step -> weather mast -> descent below ruined road bridge.
Lower-road service gate -> ski-lodge service entrance.
chronology: Days1-7: radio echo; passive receiving separated from beacon/transmission; tests.
Days8-17: portable set/spare battery/trail inspected; Loader destroys road bridge.
Days18-22: shed marks, Eve sends call, refuge shifts; emergency-power reset restarts beacon.
Days23-28: portable set recovered and tested; route and equipment prepared.
Day29: Eve/Malik place portable transmitter while Reed stays at observatory.
Day30: remote check-in, roof beacon shut, Reed follows trench/path, group descends and reaches lodge.
setups_and_payoffs: False answer hope becomes evidence-based transmitter plan.
Bridge destruction makes planted foot trail necessary.
Eve's broadcast mistake changes behavior; observed portable test and Reed's cutoff enable exit.
persistent_states: Passive receiver does not magically transmit; main automatic beacon restarts only after demonstrated supply reset.
Repeated recorded human call is an echo, not a translated alien-language command.
Portable RADIO transmitter uses previously found spare battery; recorder alone does not emit radio.
Trench hatch and weather trail planted in early map.
Reed stays behind until agreed remote signal, shuts beacon and joins; no redundant return trip.
Trail rope remains securing remote case; injuries/sleeve damage persist; no rescue aircraft.
visual_reference_status: Use existing preset main/drawing guide; prepare and inspect recurring side-character and new-location references before scenes.
